title: Hai shahadat hasan
body:
aaj majlis may sab hai khule sar
hai shahadat hassan askari ki
<<DIVIDER>>
khud imam e zamana hai muztar
hai shahadat hassan askari ki
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak udaati hai turbat may zehra
janasheen e naqi mera pota
zehr se tujhko maara sitamgar
hai shahadat hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehr ki seh ke maula aziyyat
karte hai aaj dunya se rukhsat
kamsini hi may haye muqaddar
hai shahadat hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera waali gaya aaj maara
mai hui aaj se be-sahara
kehti jaati hai narjis tadap kar
hai shahadat hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalimon ka hassan tha nishana
ro rahe hai imam e zamana
ghamzada hai ali o payambar
hai shahadat hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
lijiye momino ka bhi pursa
karte hai do mahine se girya
haq adaa ho saka na baraabar
hai shahadat hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj maghmoom shia hai saare
unke aaqa hai jannat sidhaare
kyun na roye bober bhi tadap kar
hai shahadat hassan...
author: Mir Bober Ali
